$schema_doc: Each X poll is one object. The schedule-tweets skill picks up the first poll with status='pending' and posts it via Chrome, attaching the poll widget after typing the tweet body. Each poll captures a poll_url after posting, then captures vote results 14 days after posting. Status flow: 'pending' -> 'posting' -> 'posted' -> 'closed' (results captured) -> 'failed'. X poll constraints: tweet_text up to 280 chars, 2-4 options each up to 25 chars, duration one of: 5m, 1h, 1d, 7d. total_votes is populated when results are captured. results contains the per-option breakdown.
